subQuests.subQuestName: Go and investigate where the Fungi are appearing

745070101.text: Huh? Is there something wrong with Paimon's eyes?

745070102.text: Just now... That thing which floated off ahead... was that a Fungus? Have Fungi invaded Fontaine?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the two people at the stall

745070201.text: Thank you for your cooperation. The review has been completed, and your companions are all very safe. They are of no threat to Fontaine's citizens and ecological environment.

745070202.text: As stated in the Fontaine Foreign Species Management Act and the Quartier Lyonnais Code of Business Conduct, you may proceed with your event.

745070204.text: I didn't think hosting an event in Fontaine would be this complicated. It took around ten extra steps as compared to procedures at Port Ormos. I guess my preparations weren't sufficient...

745070205.text: Don't mention it, and don't beat yourself up about it. You and your Fungi companions are special guests.

745070206.text: The Maison Gardiennage rarely comes into contact with foreign Fungi species, so proceeding with caution was necessary. It is only normal that the observation and evaluation took quite a bit of time.

745070207.text: Next, I shall be transferring your commission to the other Gardes.

745070208.text: If the rumored Golden Comet and Silver Companion are spotted, the Gardes will notify them and ask them to meet you here...

745070209.text: I hope your "Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta" goes smoothly, and you have a great time in the Court of Fontaine... If you need anything, just call for me, and I'll be there.

745070210.text: Ah, it seems that won't be necessary anymore. They are already here.

745070211.text: Wait a minute! By "Golden Comet and Silver Companion"... You refer to these... Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces?

745070212.text: Whoa! How did we suddenly become the topic of your conversation? And what's with those strange names...

745070213.text: You two are the same as ever, I see... Energetic, spirited, and with a reassuring air about you.

745070215.text: Wh—Wh—Who are you? Have we met?

745070216.text: Hmm... Your failure to remember me is my mistake. I should have done my best to maintain contact and sent a few more letters.

745070217.text: A long time ago, the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament was held in Sumeru. I participated with some prejudiced thoughts and the intent to do something dangerous...

745070218.text: You woke me up and made me change. You helped me stop hating my kind, Fungi buddies and seek the right path toward coexisting with them.

745070219.text: After the event, you became the ultimate decision-maker of the tournament, and I promised that I would do my best to continue running the event...

745070224.text: Are you... Haniyyah? The same Haniyyah who's been taking care of Bongo-Head and the other Fungi for us?

745070225.text: Yeah, that's me! Long time no see, Golden Comet, Silver Companion!

745070221.text: That voice sure is familiar, but, uh, did we know a lady like her?

745070222.text: Based on your slightly tanned skin, you're not from around here, huh?

745070223.text: Wait! Paimon kinda remembers now! This is kinda unbelievable, but...

745070301.text: Strong... Too strong... Even if it's just a tabletop game, you're still practically invulnerable!

745070302.text: P—Please go a few more rounds with me and teach me more!

745070305.text: That's a little too much, don't you think? We're just playing a game.

745070306.text: Please don't try to be humble! This tabletop game can reflect a player's ability to command...

745070307.text: The positioning of each Lil' Fungus, their opponent, skill activation rhythm, support timings... Everything is important!

745070308.text: You haven't received any command training from the Maison Gardiennage, and yet you're still able to launch joint attacks so skillfully...

745070309.text: You're not just a Super Zenith Boss-Level Force, you're a real Super Zenith Boss!

745070310.text: Are you interested in taking up a position in the Maison? I'm sure you'd become a captain in no time, and then advance further still into one of the organization's pillars...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the two people at the stall

745071402.text: But I'm well aware that I'm inferior to you in all aspects, so please go easy on me!

745071901.text: Hehe, Paimon was right! That's Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy!

745071904.text: Please wait! We'll come play with you once we finish talking to Haniyyah and Turenna!
